33700.meaning1: hard to clean; difficult to purify
33700.commentary: (SNPa) so dubbisodho hi sāṅgaṇo, cirakālaṃ tassa aṅgaṇassa vipākaṃ paccanubhonto'pi na sujjhati.

examples.text: gūthakūpo yathā assa, sampuṇṇo gaṇavassiko, yo ca evarūpo assa, dubbisodho hi sāṅgaṇo.
tasmiñ'ca dhamme sāvako viharati dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno sāmīcippaṭipanno anudhammacārī, idam'ahaṃ dubbījasmiṃ vadāmi.

33702.construction:
dur + √vass > vuss + ti + ikā
dubbuṭṭhi + ikā
33702.commentary: (DNa) suvuṭṭhikā'ti devassa sammādhār'ānuppavecchanaṃ. dubbuṭṭhikā'ti avaggāho, vassavibandho'ti vuttaṃ hoti

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, suvuṭṭhikā bhavissati, dubbuṭṭhikā bhavissati, subhikkhaṃ bhavissati, dubbhikkhaṃ bhavissati, khemaṃ bhavissati, bhayaṃ bhavissati, rogo bhavissati, ārogyaṃ bhavissati
veṇī vā avaññā honti, rathakārī ca dubbhikā, caṇḍālī kapaṇā honti, kappakā ca punappunaṃ.

33707.meaning1: loser; unlucky man; luckless wretch; (comm) dead or unconscious person
33707.commentary: (SNa) dubbhago viyā'ti mato viya, visaññī viya ca. (SNt) dubbhago vuccati nissiriko bhinnabhago, so pana matasadiso visaññisadiso ca hotī'ti āha mato viya visaññī viya cā'ti.

examples.text: kiṃ soppasi kiṃ nu soppasi, kim'idaṃ soppasi dubbhago viya, suññam'agāran'ti soppasi, kim'idaṃ soppasi sūriye uggateti.

33709.meaning1: creating bad luck; bad luck charm

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, āvāhanaṃ vivāhanaṃ saṃvaraṇaṃ vivaraṇaṃ saṃkiraṇaṃ vikiraṇaṃ subhagakaraṇaṃ dubbhagakaraṇaṃ viruddhagabbhakaraṇaṃ jivhānibandhanaṃ hanusaṃhananaṃ hatth'ābhijappanaṃ hanujappanaṃ
anusūyāyamāno so, samma'd'aññāya bhāsati, subhāsitaṃ anumodeyya, dubbhaṭṭhe n'āpasādaye.

33711.meaning2: is treacherous or unfaithful, plots against

examples.text: nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakkassa devānam'indassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi, yo'pi me assa supaccatthiko tassa'p'āhaṃ na dubbheyyan'ti.
kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho'ti kujjhanalakkhaṇo kodho ca, paravisaṃvādanalakkhaṇo musāvādo ca, sadisaṃ dassetvā vañcanalakkhaṇā nikati ca, mittadubbhanalakkhaṇo dubbho ca.

33713.meaning2: difficult to bring up or speech

examples.text: evaṃ taṃ anugacchāmi, puttam'ādāya pacchato, subharo te bhavissāmi, na te hessāmi dubbharo.

33714.meaning1: fact of being difficult to support

examples.text: dubbharatāya saṃvattanti no subharatāyā'ti
vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattanti, no kosajjāya, subharatāya saṃvattanti, no dubbharatāyā
pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti, no dubbhāsitā, anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ. katamehi pañcahi?
sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.
dubbhāsitaṃ vikkhalitaṃ, sampamohaṃ parājayaṃ, añño'ññass'ābhinandanti, tadariyo katha'n'ācare.
ime ce'pi, mahānāma, mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ime c'āhaṃ mahāsāle byākareyyaṃ, sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā'ti, kim'aṅgaṃ pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ

33717.meaning1: believing (something) to be an offence of wrong speech

33718.meaning1: who uses wrong speech; who talks maliciously

examples.text: no c'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bālo duccintitacintī ca abhavissa dubbhāsitabhāsī ca dukkaṭakammakārī ca kena naṃ paṇḍitā jāneyyuṃ, bālo ayaṃ bhavaṃ asappuriso'ti?

33719.meaning1: to know the meaning of what is badly spoken

examples.text: ayañ'ca puggalo majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāto hoti, so ca hoti paññavā ajaḷo aneḷamūgo, paṭibalo subhāsita-dubbhāsitānam'attham'aññātuṃ. ayaṃ navamo akkhaṇo asamayo brahmacariyavāsāya.

33721.meaning2: was treacherous or unfaithful, plotted against

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo asamayo padhānāya.
āgantukassa dānaṃ deti, gamikassa dānaṃ deti, gilānassa dānaṃ deti, dubbhikkhe dānaṃ deti, yāni tāni navasassāni navaphalāni tāni paṭhamaṃ sīlavantesu patiṭṭhāpeti.

33723.meaning2: with a scarcity of alms food

examples.text: tassa evam'assa, ahaṃ kho pubbe sadhano sabhogo kantār'addhānamaggaṃ paṭipajjiṃ dubbhikkhaṃ sappaṭibhayaṃ.
avuṭṭhiko janapado, dubbhikkho chātako mahā, dadāhi pavaraṃ nāgaṃ, nīlaṃ añjanasavhayaṃ.

33724.meaning1: fact of cheating; fact of deceiving; fact of plotting against; betrayal

33725.meaning2: having been treacherous or unfaithful, having plotted against

33726.meaning2: difficult to be broken or torn asunder

examples.text: asuci, duggandho, sabhīru, sappaṭibhayo, mittadubbhī, ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā mātugāme'ti.
kim'attham'abhisandhāya, lahucittassa dubbhino, sabbakāmadadass'eva, imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.

33729.meaning1: with bad earth; having infertile soil; (comm) with uneven ground

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, rājañña, kassako bījanaṅgalaṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya. so tattha dukkhette dubbhūme avihatakhāṇukaṇṭake bījāni patiṭṭhāpeyya khaṇḍāni pūtīni vāt'ātapahatāni asāradāni asukhasayitāni.

33730.meaning2: with an opening on both sides

examples.text: kappāni viceyya kevalāni, saṃsāraṃ dubhayaṃ cut'ūpapātaṃ, vigatarajam'anaṅgaṇaṃ visuddhaṃ, pattaṃ jātikhayaṃ tam'āhu buddhan'ti.
saddañ'ca sutvā dubhayaṃ piy'āppiyaṃ, piyamhi sadde na samucchito siyā, atho'ppiye dosagataṃ vinodaye, na c'āppiyaṃ me'ti manaṃ padosaye.

33732.synonym: jagatiruha, taru, pādapa, mahiruha, mahīruha, rukkha, viṭapī

examples.text: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto'ti.
madhurañ'ca pavanti sabbaso, kusumarajena samuṭṭhitā dumā, paṭhamavasanto sukho utu, ehi ramāma supupphite vane.
himavantass'āvidūre, udaṅgaṇo nāma pabbato, tatth'addasaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ, dum'aggamhi vilambitaṃ.

33734.meaning2: variety of trees, interval of trees

examples.text: upasanto uparato, mantabhāṇī anuddhato, dhunāti pāpake dhamme, dumapattaṃ'va māluto.
dumapphalānī'va patanti māṇavā, daharā ca vuḍḍhā ca sarīrabhedā, etam'pi disvā pabbajito'mhi rāja, apaṇṇakaṃ sāmaññam'eva seyyo.
ahāsi me ambaphalāni pubbe, aṇūni thūlāni ca brahmacāri, teh'eva mantehi na dāni tuyhaṃ, dumapphalā pātubhavanti brahme.

33742.meaning2: tree producing yellow flowers see kaṇikāra

33743.meaning1: based on two items; rooted in two things

33744.meaning2: who is difficult to make silent, obstinate person
33744.commentary: (VINa) dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāyā'ti dummaṅkū nāma dussīlapuggalā, ye maṅkutaṃ āpādiyamānā'pi dukkhena āpajjanti, vītikkamaṃ karontā vā katvā vā na lajjanti, tesaṃ niggahatthāya, te hi sikkhāpade asati kiṃ tumhehi diṭṭhaṃ, kiṃ sutaṃ, kiṃ amhehi kataṃ, katarasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ katamaṃ āpattiṃ āropetvā amhe niggaṇhathā'ti saṅghaṃ viheṭhessanti, sikkhāpade pana sati te saṅgho sikkhāpadaṃ dassetvā dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena niggahessati. tena vuttaṃ, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāyā'ti.

examples.text: tena hi, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapessāmi dasa atthavase paṭicca, saṅghasuṭṭhutāya, saṅghaphāsutāya, dummaṅkūnaṃ puggalānaṃ niggahāya, pesalānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ phāsuvihārāya, diṭṭhadhammikānaṃ āsavānaṃ saṃvarāya, samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāya, appasannānaṃ pasādāya, pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya, saddhammaṭṭhitiyā, vinay'ānuggahāya.

33746.meaning1: unhappy; sad; disappointed; depressed; dejected; in low spirits
33746.commentary: (ANa) na dummano'ti aniṭṭh'ārammaṇe paṭighavasena na domanassajāto hoti.

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā, jānāti maṃ uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī'ti dukkhī dummano tatth'ev'antaradhāyī'ti.
evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa kho, vappa, bhikkhuno cha satatavihārā adhigatā honti. so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā n'eva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.

33747.meaning1: bad advice; poor counsel; rotten plan
33747.commentary: (THa) n'etaṃ dummantitaṃ mamā'ti yaṃ tadā mayā satthu santike pabbajissāmī'ti mantitaṃ, idam'pi mama na dummantitaṃ, sumantitam'eva.

examples.text: svāgataṃ n'āpagataṃ, na'y'idaṃ dummantitaṃ mama, saṃvibhattesu dhammesu, yaṃ seṭṭhaṃ tadupāgamaṃ.
atha kho dummukho licchaviputto saccakaṃ nigaṇṭhaputtaṃ tuṇhībhūtaṃ maṅkubhūtaṃ pattakkhandhaṃ adhomukhaṃ pajjhāyantaṃ appaṭibhānaṃ viditvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upamā maṃ, bhagavā, paṭibhātī'ti.

33751.meaning1: stupidity; foolishness; ignorance; lack of wisdom
33751.commentary: (NIDD1a) yaṃ etasmiṃ anuppajjamāne cittasantānaṃ mejjhaṃ bhaveyya suci vodānaṃ, taṃ duṭṭhuṃ mejjhaṃ iminā'ti dummejjhaṃ.

examples.text: avijjā'ti… dummejjhaṃ bālyaṃ asampajaññaṃ moho pamoho sammoho avijjā avijj'ogho avijjāyogo avijj'ānusayo avijjāpariyuṭṭhānaṃ avijjālaṅgī moho akusalamūlaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, avijjā.

33752.synonym: añña, apaṇḍita, appabuddhi, avicakkhaṇa, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedhī, nippañña, bāla, bālavant, mūḷharūpa

examples.text: caranti bālā dummedhā, amitten'eva attanā, karontā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, yaṃ hoti kaṭukapphalaṃ.
atha pāpāni kammāni, karaṃ bālo na bujjhati, sehi kammehi dummedho, aggidaḍḍho'va tappati.
dummedhehi pasaṃsā ca, viññūhi garahā ca yā, garahāva seyyo viññūhi, yaṃ ce bālappasaṃsanā.

33756.synonym: añña, apaṇḍita, appabuddhi, avicakkhaṇa, duppañña, duppaññajātika, dummedha, nippañña, bāla, bālavant, mūḷharūpa

examples.text: pamādam'anuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ'ca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ'va rakkhati.

33759.meaning1: bad; badly; wrong; ill; difficult; hard
33759.notes: Frequently listed as du- in grammars, but based on sandhi, the correct form must be dur-.

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.
durāsado duppasaho, gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo, atho atthe anatthe ca, ubhayassa hoti kovido.

33760.meaning1: badly taught; poorly preached; badly explained

examples.text: evarūpe kho, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo satthari pataṃ kissa hetu? evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.

33761.meaning1: fact (of something) being badly taught; fact of being poorly preached
33761.construction:
dur + ā + √khā + ta + tta
durakkhāta + tta

examples.text: taṃ kissa hetu? durakkhātattā, bhikkhave, dhammassā'ti.

33762.meaning1: hard to protect; difficult to guard

33763.meaning1: difficult to escape; hard to cross; hard to overcome; difficult to get past

examples.text: yo c'etaṃ sahate jammiṃ, taṇhaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, sokā tamhā papatanti, udabindu'va pokkharā.
yo'dha kāme accatari, saṅgaṃ loke duraccayaṃ, na so socati n'ājjheti, chinnasoto abandhano.
tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

33769.meaning1: hard to understand; difficult to comprehend
33769.commentary: (MNa) duranubodho, dukkhena avabujjhitabbo, na sakkā sukhena avabujjhituṃ.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, adhigato kho my'āyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakk'āvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.

33772.meaning1: difficult to follow; tricky to trace; hard to understand; (comm) difficult to know
33772.commentary: (DHPa) gati tesaṃ durannayā'ti… gati durannayā na sakkā jānituṃ… gamanassa apaññāyanato gati durannayā na sakkā paññāpetun'ti.

examples.text: yesaṃ sannicayo n'atthi, ye pariññātabhojanā, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, gati tesaṃ durannayā.
yass'āsavā parikkhīṇā, āhāre ca anissito, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yassa gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, padaṃ tassa durannayaṃ.

33773.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: durannayo saṅgho atho'pi ujjayo, aparo muni sayho anomanikkamo, ānando nando upanando dvādasa, bhāradvājo antimadehadhārī.

33774.meaning1: difficult to follow; hard to emulate; difficult to imitate; hard to do

examples.text: duddadaṃ dadamānānaṃ, dukkaraṃ kamma kubbataṃ, asanto n'ānukubbanti, sataṃ dhammo duranvayo.

33775.meaning1: difficult to enjoy; hard to find pleasure in

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

33776.meaning1: troublesome; hard to endure; difficult to withstand; beset with difficulties
33776.commentary: (MNa) durabhisambhavāni hī'ti sambhavituṃ dukkhāni dussahāni, na sakkā app'esakkhehi ajjhogāhitun'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNa) durabhisambhavan'ti duppasahaṃ.

examples.text: durabhisambhavāni hi kho, bho gotama, araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni, dukkaraṃ pavivekaṃ, durabhiramaṃ ekatte, haranti maññe mano vanāni samādhiṃ alabhamānassa bhikkhuno'ti.

33777.construction:
dur + abhi + saṃ + √bhū > bhav + *a + tara
durabhisambhava + tara

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, pukkusa, katamaṃ nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭasatāni nissāya nissāya atikkantāni n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya, yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n'eva passeyya, na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyā'ti?
khamā bhavissāma sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ

33779.meaning1: hard to understand; difficult to comprehend

examples.text: passa dhammaṃ durājānaṃ, sampamūḷh'etth'aviddasu, nivutānaṃ tamo hoti, andhakāro apassataṃ.

33782.meaning1: hard to approach; difficult to assault; hard to attack
33782.commentary: (ANa) durāsado duppasaho'ti parehi ghaṭṭetuṃ vā abhibhavituṃ vā na sakkā. (APAa) mama sissā durāsadā'ti imehi vuttappakāraguṇehi samannāgatattā āsādetuṃ ghaṭṭetuṃ asakkuṇeyyā mama sissā'ti sambandho.

examples.text: durāsado duppasaho, gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo, atho atthe anatthe ca, ubhayassa hoti kovido.
pallaṅkena nisajjāya, ṭhānacaṅkamanena ca, vītināmenti te rattiṃ, mama sissā durāsadā.

33783.meaning1: difficult to live in; hard to stay in

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

33785.commentary: (ANa) duruttānan'ti na suṭṭhu vuttānaṃ dosavasena pavattitānaṃ pharusavacanānaṃ.

examples.text: khamā bhavissāma sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
atthi āsavā adhivāsanā pahātabbā, duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ, uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ

33787.meaning1: hard to approach; difficult to visit
33787.commentary: (DNa) durupasaṅkamā'ti dupayirupāsiyā. ahaṃ sarāgo sadoso samoho, satthā vītarāgo vītadoso vītamoho, tasmā dupayirupāsiyā tathāgatā mādisena.

examples.text: atha kho sakko devānam'indo pañcasikhaṃ gandhabbadevaputtaṃ āmantesi, durupasaṅkamā kho, tāta pañcasikha, tathāgatā mādisena, jhāyī jhānaratā, tadantaraṃ paṭisallīnā.
ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena m'idh'ekacco mātugāmo dubbaṇṇā ca hoti durūpā supāpikā dassanāya, daliddā ca hoti appassakā appabhogā app'esakkhā ca?
kathañ'ca bhikkhu karuṇāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati? seyyathā'pi nāma ekaṃ puggalaṃ duggataṃ durūpetaṃ disvā karuṇāyeyya, evam'eva sabbasatte karuṇāya pharatī'ti
so, duggataṃ durūpetan'ti pāḷiyā na sameti, tasmā vuttanayen'ev'ettha bhāvanam'ārabhitvā sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā appanā vaḍḍhetabbā.

33794.grammar: ind, from acc sg of dulladdha, impers (+dat)
33794.meaning1: it is unfortunate; it is unlucky (for)
33794.construction:
dur + √labh > ladh + ta + aṃ
dulladdha + aṃ
33794.commentary: (VINa) dulladdhaṃ vata me'ti idaṃ sāsanaṃ laddham'pi me dulladdhaṃ.

examples.text: tassa te, āvuso, alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamānena na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi karosī'ti, idaṃ tasmiṃ mohanake pācittiyaṃ.
alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me anabhirati uppannā

33796.meaning1: difficult to find; hard to obtain; rare (for)

examples.text: saṃkhittena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, vitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, saṃkhittavitthārena'pi kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, aññātāro ca dullabhā'ti.
attā hi attano nātho, ko hi nātho paro siyā, attanā hi sudantena, nāthaṃ labhati dullabhaṃ.

33797.meaning1: which is difficult to find; something hard to obtain; which is rare

examples.text: dullabhaṃ vā'pi labhanti, cittavūpasame ratā, yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, bhāvanāya rato mano'ti.

33798.meaning2: more difficult to obtain; very rare

examples.text: khippataraṃ kho so, bhikkhave, kāṇo kacchapo amusmiṃ ekacchiggale yuge gīvaṃ paveseyya, ato dullabhatar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, manussattaṃ vadāmi sakiṃ vinipātagatena bālena.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, dubbhikkhaṃ hoti dussassaṃ dullabhapiṇḍaṃ, na sukaraṃ uñchena paggahena yāpetuṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo asamayo padhānāya.
